title: 第15章 你该怎么补偿第16章 一枚小牌子
slug: 快穿之时空星河伴第九章误闯雾山
content_zh:
沐梓丞继续安抚着昔小苑说道：“别怕，你就把他们当做不会动的东西，当摆饰就好。”
昔小苑都要被气笑了，这是在安慰她吗？难道不是在吓她吗？？
昔小苑有些埋怨，悠悠的说道：“尸体会动的话那不就是诈尸了吗…”
沐梓丞他虽然不怎么会安慰人，但是她这么委屈巴巴的这么一说他突然觉得很是好笑，他被昔小苑这句话给逗乐了。
“噗嗤…哈哈哈~”沐梓丞忍不住笑了，手放在鼻子下偷笑着。
昔小苑被沐梓丞这么一笑，她自己也突然跟着笑了起来，好吧，她也被她自己说的话给戳中笑点了。
昔小苑抬头看着沐梓丞，虽然很暗，但是窗户外的月光照射进来，她能很好的看见沐梓丞那好看的脸被月光沐浴着，她现在觉得周围突然都柔和了起来……
而且她感觉他身上有股淡淡的清香味，闻起来她就感觉到自己像是在一个冬天的雪地里一样冰冰凉凉，还有股清凉的泉水一样透进心里，让她稳定心神，而且这香味有些熟悉，好像在哪闻过……
然而她感觉现在的自己没那么害怕了。
而且小丞丞他笑起来的声音很是好听，就像下雨时那小水滴落下的声音让人感觉到安心那种，她都觉得他是个自带光芒的白天使一样呢。
沐梓丞看昔小苑都笑了，沐梓丞微微一笑柔声说道：“还害怕吗？”
昔小苑缓缓的放开了沐梓丞，摇了摇头说道：“不怎么害怕了。”
虽然昔小苑放开了沐梓丞，但是她的手还是牢牢的抓着沐梓丞的衣袖。
沐梓丞点了点头，说了一句很是欠揍的话，说道：“吾的衣服被你弄脏了，吾的衣服可是很珍贵的呢，布料是很难寻的，吾的衣料可是一种叫银丝雪的绸缎制作而成，吾那边至今世上就只有两匹，一匹绸缎已经被吾制作成了这衣裳，还有一匹～可是天神的呢。你说~你现在弄脏了一件这么珍贵的衣服该怎么赔偿吾呢？？”
昔小苑本来还对沐梓丞抱有好感的，现在觉得…不！是她想多了，她不应该对他这么依旧腹黑很坏的人抱有好感！！
昔小苑被沐梓丞这么一说，她现在对地上周围的尸体都不怎么害怕了，她还觉得地上的尸体都比沐梓丞顺眼多了。
昔小苑深吸一口气，虽然呼吸的空气里都是一股血腥味。她随后稳了稳自己的心态说道：“你这衣裳怎么…就这么的稀缺和珍贵呢，是有什么功效还是什么的…才这么的珍贵呢？？休想骗我了。”
沐梓丞凑近昔小苑，低下头盯着昔小苑跟她对视着，缓缓说道：“这衣裳呢，穿起来很轻，风一吹就飘飘然，不仅如此，布料触感还很柔软舒适，最重要的还是……”
昔小苑眉头紧锁一脸疑惑的说道：“还是什么？能别卖关子了行不。”
沐梓丞继续凑近昔小苑，两人的脸离得很近很近都能亲在一起了，昔小苑看沐梓丞凑她这么近，她内心慌得一批，紧张的手抓着沐梓丞的衣袖都加重了力道。

沐梓丞突然撇过脸凑近昔小苑的耳朵说道：“最重要就是这衣服能变化很多款式的衣裳，只要吾想，什么样的衣裳都有，但是因为吾现在一点法力都没有，还怎么把这衣裳弄干净呢？！”
昔小苑不爽的嘟囔了一下嘴巴，好的吧，都是她的错。
昔小苑有些认命的对沐梓丞说道：“那你说该怎么赔偿吧，我什么值钱的东西都没有，更何况我也没东西赔你。”
沐梓丞摸了摸下巴思考了下说道：“也是，看你这穷酸样也是赔不起的了，那你就先欠着吧，吾哪天想到什么了你在补偿给我。”
昔小苑突然脑回路有点缓慢还是啥的，突然抓到一个点，有些疑问的对沐梓丞说道：“法力？你的法力到底是什么样的，跟电视剧一样那种魔幻的样子吗？？你不会随便挖了个坑让我跳吧？”
沐梓丞不紧不慢缓缓的说道：“吾没挖坑，哪来的坑。魔幻？电视剧？你说的都是些什么乱七八糟的东西…算了~吾当做个好事跟你解说一下。”
“内力呢就是另一种体内运行的一种力量，功力就是吾凡人还没上升为大神的时候修炼的，现在吾身为十大大神之一的一个，当然修炼的就是是法力了，法力分为很多阶段……”
“而后就是法术，法力跟法术一运合就会释放出一种能量…法术各有不同，也分为很多种，随着法诀释放出来的都是不同的攻击和招式，算了…吾也懒得跟你说太多，看你那小脑瓜也是听不懂得了。”
昔小苑听的一脸蒙圈，行吧，她是没怎么听懂，但是大概就知道一个轮廓吧。
昔小苑看沐梓丞这么的嫌弃她，不高心的说道：“不懂就不懂呗，算了…我们还是走吧，这里真的是……血腥味太重了，哪天你想好了，我在赔偿你，反正我也没什么好赔你的了。”
…………………分割线………………
一个亮着灯的房间里，桌子旁边坐着三个人，俞月白昔小苑、还有一个透明隐身的沐梓丞，他们看着前方的张文抓着一个被绑着的土匪。

土匪脸青鼻肿的，一脸怨恨不爽的瞪着昔小苑他们，看那个女子应该就是丞相了，可恶！竟然被他们摆了一道，都是那个小白脸的错，竟然男扮女装，这什么癖好。
俞月白凶凶的对土匪说道：“瞪什么瞪，信不信本公子把你眼睛给挖下来。”
土匪嘴巴被塞着一块布，他想说话也没法开口，嘴巴都被堵着，他现在就只能干瞪着眼。
content_en:
Mu Zicheng continued to comfort Xi Xiaoyuan and said, "Don't be afraid, just treat them as immobile objects and decorations."
Xi Xiaoyuan almost laughed out loud. Was this trying to comfort her? Aren't you scaring her? ?
Xi Xiaoyuan complained a little and said leisurely: "If the corpse can move, wouldn't it be a corpse fraud..."
Although Mu Zicheng was not very good at comforting others, he suddenly felt very funny when she said this aggrievedly. He was amused by Xi Xiaoyuan's words.
"Pfft... Hahaha~" Mu Zicheng couldn't help but laugh, putting his hand under his nose and snickering.
When Xi Xiaoyuan smiled like this from Mu Zicheng, she suddenly started laughing too. Well, she was also struck by what she said.
Xi Xiaoyuan looked up at Mu Zicheng. Although it was very dark, the moonlight outside the window shone in, and she could see Mu Zicheng's beautiful face bathed in the moonlight. Now she felt that the surroundings suddenly became softer...
And she felt that there was a faint fragrance on his body. When she smelled it, she felt as cold as being in the snow in winter, and there was also a cool spring water penetrating into her heart, which calmed her mind. Moreover, the fragrance was somewhat familiar, as if she had smelled it somewhere...
However, she felt less scared now.
And the sound of Xiao Chengcheng's laughter was very pleasant, just like the sound of small water drops falling when it rains, which makes people feel reassured. She felt that he was a white angel with his own light.
Mu Zicheng looked at Xi Xiaoyuan and smiled. Mu Zicheng smiled slightly and said softly: "Are you still scared?"
Xi Xiaoyuan slowly let go of Mu Zicheng, shook his head and said, "I'm not so scared anymore."
Although Xi Xiaoyuan let go of Mu Zicheng, her hands were still firmly holding Mu Zicheng's sleeves.
Mu Zicheng nodded and said something very shameful, saying: "My clothes were stained by you. My clothes are very precious. The fabric is hard to find. The material of my clothes is made of a kind of silk satin called Silver Snow. OK, I only have two pieces in the world, one piece of silk has been made into this dress, and one piece belongs to the God. You think, how should you compensate me for soiling such a precious piece of clothing?"
Xi Xiaoyuan originally had a good impression of Mu Zicheng, but now she feels... no! She was overthinking it. She shouldn't have a favorable impression of someone like him who was still evil and evil! !
After Mu Zicheng said this to Xi Xiaoyuan, she was no longer afraid of the corpses around her. She also felt that the corpses on the ground were more pleasing to Mu Zicheng's eyes.
Xi Xiaoyuan took a deep breath, even though the air he breathed was filled with the smell of blood. She then calmed down and said, "Why are your clothes... so rare and precious? Does it have some effect or something... to make it so precious? Don't even think about lying to me."
Mu Zicheng came closer to Xi Xiaoyuan, lowered his head and stared at Xi Xiaoyuan, looking at her, and said slowly: "These clothes are very light to wear and flutter when the wind blows. Not only that, the fabric feels very soft and comfortable. The most important thing is..."
Xi Xiaoyuan frowned and said with confusion: "What else? Can you please stop showing off."
Mu Zicheng continued to get closer to Xi Xiaoyuan, their faces were so close that they could kiss each other. When Xi Xiaoyuan saw Mu Zicheng coming so close to her, she panicked inside, and her nervous hands grabbed Mu Zicheng's sleeves harder.
Mu Zicheng suddenly turned his face and leaned into Xi Xiaoyuan's ear and said: "The most important thing is that this clothes can be transformed into many styles of clothes. As long as I want, I can have all kinds of clothes. But since I don't have any mana now, how can I clean these clothes?!"
Xi Xiaoyuan muttered unhappily, okay, it's all her fault.
Xi Xiaoyuan said to Mu Zicheng with some resignation: "Then what do you think should be done to compensate me?There is nothing of value, not to mention I have nothing to compensate you. "
Mu Zicheng touched his chin, thought for a moment, and said, "That's right, you are so poor that you can't afford to pay, so you just owe it first, and if I think of something one day, you can compensate me. "
Xi Xiaoyuan's brain circuit suddenly became a little slow or something, and he suddenly caught a point, and said to Mu Zicheng with some doubts: "Magic power? What does your magic look like? Is it as magical as the TV show? ? You wouldn't just dig a hole for me to jump into, would you? "
Mu Zicheng said slowly and unhurriedly: "I didn't dig a hole, where did it come from? Magical? TV drama? What you are talking about are all nonsense...forget it~ I will explain it to you as a good thing. "
"Internal power is another kind of power that runs in the body. Skill is what I cultivated before I became a great god. Now that I am one of the ten great gods, of course I practice mana. Mana is divided into many stages..."
"Then there are spells. When mana and spells are combined, a kind of energy will be released... Spells are different, and they are divided into many types. Different attacks and moves are released along with the spells. Forget it... I am too lazy to tell you too much. It seems that your little brain can't understand it. "
Xi Xiaoyuan was confused when she heard it, okay, she didn't understand much, but she probably knew the outline.
Seeing that Mu Zicheng disliked her so much, Xi Xiaoyuan said unhappily: "If you don't understand, just don't understand. Forget it... let's go. The smell of blood here is really... too strong. One day, if you think about it, I will compensate you. Anyway, I have nothing to compensate you." "

The bandit's face was bruised and his nose was swollen, and he stared at Xi Xiaoyuan and the others with resentment and displeasure. It seemed that the woman must be the prime minister. Damn it! They actually made a fool of themselves, it was all that pretty boy's fault, he actually dressed up as a woman, what kind of hobby is this.
Yu Yuebai said to the bandit fiercely: "Why are you staring? Believe it or not, I will dig out your eyes. "
The bandit's mouth was stuffed with a piece of cloth. He couldn't speak even if he wanted to. His mouth was blocked and he could only stare.
